## Minimal reproduction

Use the matching standalone Ollama executable and a free port 11535. The commands use a temporary store under the canary home.

```sh
set -eu
canary_home="${CANARY_HOME:-$HOME/.stack-canary}"
mkdir -p "$canary_home"
repro_dir=$(mktemp -d "$canary_home/repro.XXXXXX")
mkdir -p "$repro_dir/home" "$repro_dir/models" "$repro_dir/tmp"
export HOME="$repro_dir/home" OLLAMA_MODELS="$repro_dir/models" TMPDIR="$repro_dir/tmp"
export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11535
export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=8192
export OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1
export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m
export OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0
export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1
export OLLAMA_NOPRUNE=1
export OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1
export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1
ollama serve &
server_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
sleep 1
kill -0 "$server_pid"
ollama pull qwen3.5:0.8b
curl --noproxy '*' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"model": "canary-qwen3.5-0.8b", "from": "qwen3.5:0.8b", "stream": false, "parameters": {"temperature": 0, "seed": 42}}' http://127.0.0.1:11535/api/create
curl --noproxy '*' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"model": "canary-qwen3.5-0.8b", "temperature": 0, "seed": 42, "max_tokens": 256, "stream": false, "reasoning_effort": "none", "tools": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "write_file", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}, "content": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["path", "content"]}}}], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Use the write_file tool to write box.ts with exactly this content: type Box<T=any> = { value: T };"}]}' http://127.0.0.1:11535/v1/chat/completions
```
